## Code failures per prompt and seed

Failed tasks are put into one category, checked in this order: **wrong logic** (the graded code defines the entry point, a test fails: wrong result, error or timeout); **empty at cap** (counted under "No usable code": no code extracted because the answer stopped at the 8192-token limit; an empty solution is graded as a failure, as in EvalPlus and the TaH2 harness); **entry point not defined**; **no usable code** (the rest, e.g. sanitize dropped code it could not parse, or the answer is a script that reads input instead of a function). Percentages are shares of the failures.

| Prompt | Benchmark | Seed | Failures / tasks | Entry point not defined | No usable code | …of which empty at cap | Wrong logic |

## Runs: restarts and throughput

**Throughput** (tok/s) is generated tokens divided by the time the engine spent generating; it excludes model loading and grading.

| Benchmark | Cap | tok/s (seeds 42 / 1234 / 2024) | Restarts |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| AIME25 | 8192 | 802 / 721 / 805 | 37 / 46 / 38 |
| AMC23 | 8192 | — / 888 / 885 | 0* / 44 / 57 |
| OlympiadBench | 8192 | 777 / 872 / 879 | 130 / 91 / 81 |
| MATH500 | 8192 | 1002 / 1068 / 1080 | 8 / 0 / 0 |
| GPQA-Diamond | 8192 | 649 / 726 / 703 | 30 / 39 / 55 |
| HumanEval+ (harness prompt) | 8192 | 342 / 360 / 321 | 0 / 0 / 0 |
| HumanEval+ (TaH2 prompt) | 8192 | 955 / 1036 / 1063 | 0 / 0 / 0 |
| MBPP+ (harness prompt) | 8192 | 484 / 613 / 682 | 0 / 0 / 0 |
| MBPP+ (TaH2 prompt) | 8192 | 922 / 999 / 1026 | 5 / 0 / 0 |
| GSM8K | 4096 | 2220 / 2216 / 2228 | 0 / 0 / 0 |
| MMLU-STEM | 4096 | 1862 / 1889 / 1888 | 0 / 0 / 0 |

Some requests were restarted after a host-memory overflow; the restarted samples are complete and valid, and the per-run counts are in the table. \* Seed-42 AMC23 was resumed after an out-of-memory failure. Its first attempt left no telemetry, so the restart count and throughput are incomplete; one unfinished duplicate was dropped (amc23_33, sample 6, an ungraded copy from the crashed sub-run).

## Datasets as used

| Benchmark | Problems | Samples per problem | Max new tokens | Source | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| AIME25 | 30 | 8 | 8192 | `yentinglin/aime_2025, split train` | revision 6f71d77 |
| AMC23 | 40 | 8 | 8192 | `math-ai/amc23, split test` | revision 80815d3 |
| OlympiadBench | 675 | 1 | 8192 | `realtreetune/olympiadbench, split test` | revision ba3660e |
| MATH500 | 500 | 1 | 8192 | `HuggingFaceH4/MATH-500, split test` | revision 6e4ed1a |
| GPQA-Diamond | 198 | 1 | 8192 | `data/initial_data/eval/gpqa_diamond.jsonl` | SHA256 51bdd0439e76… |
| HumanEval+ | 164 | 1 | 8192 | `data/initial_data/eval/humaneval.jsonl` | SHA256 42526ec0e7d5…; tests: EvalPlus HumanEvalPlus v0.1.10 |
| MBPP+ | 378 | 1 | 8192 | `data/initial_data/eval/mbpp.jsonl` | SHA256 b54e76275524…; tests: EvalPlus MbppPlus v0.2.0 |
| GSM8K | 1319 | 1 | 4096 | `pss0204/gsm8k_test, gsm8k_test, split test` | revision 4bddd01 |
| MMLU-STEM | 3153 | 1 | 4096 | `data/initial_data/eval/mmlu_stem.jsonl` | SHA256 289fa37f4fa0… |

Hub datasets are pinned by the revision in the local Hugging Face cache that the runs loaded; local files by SHA256. EvalPlus (the code test suite) contributes the extra tests and the grader. One seed of the protocol is 6,947 graded answers.

**Reproduce:** `./reproduce.sh curate` writes `data/datasets.json`.
